nvitk.db.xnat
=============

.. py:module:: nvitk.db.xnat

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   XNAT client helpers: sessions, scan resolution, DICOM/NIfTI downloads, project sync into catalog tables.

   Depends on the ``xnat`` package and :mod:`nvitk.db.xnat_config` for host/project credentials.

Module Contents

.. py:data:: click
   :value: None


.. py:data:: log

.. py:data:: xnat
   :value: None


.. py:function:: _cli_decorator(*args, **kwargs)

   No-op stand-in for ``click.command``/``click.option`` when ``click`` isn't installed.


.. py:data:: _click_command

.. py:data:: _click_option

.. py:function:: _normalize_header(value: str) -> str

   Lower-case *value* and strip everything but alphanumerics, for loose CSV header matching.


.. py:function:: _detect_catalog_column(fieldnames: list[str], candidates: Iterable[str]) -> str | None

   Return the first entry in *fieldnames* that normalizes to match one of *candidates*, or ``None``.


.. py:function:: load_subject_catalog_rows(path: str | pathlib.Path) -> list[dict[str, str]]

   Read a subject-catalog CSV at *path* into a list of ``{column: value}`` row dicts.


.. py:function:: parse_subject_tokens(subjects: str | Iterable[str] | None) -> list[str]

   Split a comma/whitespace-separated *subjects* string (or pass through an iterable) into a
   flat list of non-empty tokens.


.. py:function:: resolve_subject_labels(*, catalog_path: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, subjects: str | Iterable[str] | None = None, subjects_file: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, id_type: str = 'subject') -> list[str]

   Resolve the requested subject labels from (in priority order) a *subjects_file*, an inline
   *subjects* string/iterable, or a *catalog_path* CSV. When reading from the catalog with
   ``id_type="mrid"``, MR IDs are looked up and translated back to subject labels via the same CSV.
   Returns a sorted, de-duplicated list; empty if none of the three sources is given.


.. py:function:: parse_requested_sequences(requested: str | Iterable[str] | None) -> list[str]

   Split ``requested_sequences`` on commas; spaces inside a token are kept until normalized.


.. py:function:: _normalize_sequence_request_token(token: str) -> str

   Canonical sequence key for filtering (aligned with :func:`classify_scan` ``sequence``).


.. py:data:: _BRAINVIEW_SERIES_RE

.. py:data:: _BRAINVIEW_VARIANT_PREFIX_RE

.. py:data:: VWI_BB_VARIANT_PRIORITY
   :type:  tuple[str, Ellipsis]
   :value: ('strong', 'default', 'weak')


.. py:function:: parse_brainview_variant(series_description: str | None, quality: str | None = None) -> str | None

   Return ``strong`` / ``default`` / ``weak`` for BrainVIEW T1W, else None.


.. py:function:: select_preferred_vwi_bb_scan(candidates: list[dict[str, Any]], *, subject_label: str = '') -> dict[str, Any] | None

   Pick one VWI_BB scan: strong, then default, then weak.


.. py:function:: infer_flow_orientation(description: str) -> str

   Classify a 4D-flow scan's series *description* as ``AP``/``RL``/``FH`` orientation tokens, or
   ``GENERIC`` if none match.


.. py:function:: classify_scan(series_description: str | None, quality: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any] | None

   Classify a scan by its *series_description* (and optional QC *quality*) into a
   ``{modality, orientation, sequence, ...}`` dict, matching BrainVIEW/VWI_BB, TOF/MRA, 4D-flow, resting-
   state fMRI, carotid QF, QSM/SWI, and other known sequence patterns in priority order. Returns
   ``None`` when the description matches nothing, or when *quality* is present and not ``"usable"``
   (except for the BrainVIEW/VWI_BB case, which is quality-independent).


.. py:function:: resolve_xnat_scan_from_scan_row(session: Any, row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Any

   Return the XNAT *scan* handle for a ``scans`` table row (uses ``session_uid`` and ``scan_id``).


.. py:function:: xnat_sequence_to_asset_slot(sequence_label: str) -> str

   Map XNAT sequence labels (see :func:`classify_scan`) to canonical ``asset_slot`` names.


.. py:data:: _ASSET_SLOT_LABELS
   :type:  dict[str, str]

.. py:function:: asset_slot_display_label(asset_slot: str) -> str

   Human-readable label for catalog ``asset_slot`` keys.


.. py:function:: requested_sequence_set(requested: str | Iterable[str] | None) -> set[str]

   Normalize ``requested_sequences`` tokens to the same keys :func:`classify_scan` uses for ``sequence``.


.. py:function:: _coalesce_attr(obj: Any, *names: str) -> Any

   Return the first non-``None`` value among *obj*'s *names* attributes, calling zero-arg callables.


.. py:function:: _netrc_host_candidates(server: str) -> list[str]

   Bare hostnames to try (host, then parent domain ``a.b.c`` → ``b.c``).


.. py:function:: _netrc_machine_candidates(server: str) -> list[str]

   Ordered *machine* strings for ~/.netrc lookup.


.. py:function:: _normalize_netrc_machine(machine: str) -> str

   Canonical host for comparing netrc ``machine`` names (handles trailing slashes).


.. py:function:: _credentials_from_netrc(server: str, netrc_path: str | pathlib.Path, *, preferred_user: str | None = None) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]

   Return (login, password) from a netrc file for *server*, or (None, None).

   If *preferred_user* is set, only an entry whose login matches is returned
   (so explicit ``config.user`` can be paired with the password from netrc).


.. py:function:: _xnat_auth_help_message(config: nvitk.db.xnat_config.XnatConnectionConfig, *, netrc_path: pathlib.Path | None = None) -> str

   Build a human-readable message listing the supported ways to supply XNAT credentials, for use in
   the authentication error raised when none of them resolved.


.. py:function:: _resolve_xnat_login(config: nvitk.db.xnat_config.XnatConnectionConfig) -> tuple[str | None, str | None, pathlib.Path | None]

   Resolve (user, password, netrc_path_used) for *config*, filling in any missing credential from
   ``config.netrc_file`` if set, else from ``~/.netrc`` when a user is known but the password isn't.


.. py:function:: connect_xnat(config: nvitk.db.xnat_config.XnatConnectionConfig)

   Open an ``xnat`` session for *config*, resolving credentials via :func:`_resolve_xnat_login`.
   Raises ``BackendUnavailableError`` if the ``xnat`` package isn't installed, or an XNAT auth error
   (with a help message) if no usable credentials were found.


.. py:function:: _download_scan_bundle(scan: Any, zip_path: pathlib.Path, *, resource_label: str = 'DICOM') -> pathlib.Path

   Download a single scan resource bundle (``DICOM`` by default).

   Prefers the per-resource ``scan.resources[resource_label].download(...)`` so
   that only the requested asset type is transferred (XNAT's whole-scan
   ``scan.download()`` bundles every resource — DICOM, NIFTI, SNAPSHOTS, ...).
   Falls back to the whole-scan download only when the resource isn't exposed;
   callers are responsible for filtering non-target members in that case.


.. py:function:: _is_non_dicom_member(member_name: str) -> bool

   Reject obvious non-DICOM archive members (NIfTI, JSON sidecars, snapshots, ...).


.. py:function:: _download_resource_bundle(scan: Any, zip_path: pathlib.Path, resource_label: str) -> pathlib.Path

   Download a scan resource (e.g. ``NIFTI``) to ``zip_path``; returns path to zip or bundle.


.. py:function:: _is_nifti_filename(name: str) -> bool

   True if *name* has a ``.nii`` or ``.nii.gz`` extension.


.. py:function:: _is_json_sidecar_filename(name: str) -> bool

   True if *name* has a ``.json`` extension.


.. py:function:: _extract_zip_member_flat(archive: zipfile.ZipFile, member: zipfile.ZipInfo, destination: pathlib.Path) -> pathlib.Path

   Write one archive file to ``destination`` using basename only; resolve name collisions.


.. py:function:: download_scan_niftis(scan: Any, output_dir: str | pathlib.Path, *, resource_label: str = 'NIFTI', keep_zip: bool = False) -> list[pathlib.Path]

   Download and extract NIfTI files from an XNAT scan resource into ``output_dir``.


.. py:function:: _list_local_nifti_files(directory: pathlib.Path) -> list[pathlib.Path]

   Sorted list of ``.nii``/``.nii.gz`` files directly under *directory* (empty if it doesn't exist).


.. py:function:: download_scan_dicoms(scan: Any, output_dir: str | pathlib.Path, *, keep_zip: bool = False, resource_label: str = 'DICOM') -> list[pathlib.Path]

   Download a scan's DICOM resource (only) and extract it flat under ``output_dir``.

   The default ``resource_label="DICOM"`` ensures only DICOM files are pulled
   from XNAT, even when the scan also has a sibling ``NIFTI`` resource. As a
   safety net, NIfTI / JSON / sidecar members are dropped from the extracted
   archive (relevant if the per-resource download isn't available and the
   fallback to ``scan.download()`` includes other resources).


.. py:function:: list_subjects_for_project(repo: Any, project_id: str) -> list[str]

   Distinct ``subject_uid`` values with sessions in *project_id*.


.. py:function:: list_xnat_project_subject_labels(config: nvitk.db.xnat_config.XnatConnectionConfig) -> list[str]

   Sorted subject labels in the XNAT project from *config*.


.. py:function:: list_scans_for_subject(repo: Any, project_id: str, subject_uid: str) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Scans for *subject_uid* in *project_id* (joined with sessions).


.. py:function:: _project_subject_scan_asset_slots(repo: Any, project_id: str) -> dict[str, set[str]]

   Map each ``subject_uid`` in *project_id* to indexed scan ``asset_slot`` values.


.. py:function:: _project_subject_pipeline_asset_slots(repo: Any, project_id: str) -> dict[str, set[str]]

   Pipeline ``asset_slot`` values from indexed ``assets`` rows.


.. py:function:: project_subject_asset_slots(repo: Any, project_id: str) -> dict[str, set[str]]

   Map each ``subject_uid`` in *project_id* to indexed scan + pipeline ``asset_slot`` values.


.. py:function:: list_asset_slots_for_project(repo: Any, project_id: str) -> list[str]

   Sorted distinct ``asset_slot`` values indexed for *project_id*.


.. py:function:: filter_subjects_by_asset_slots(subject_slots: dict[str, set[str]], required_slots: set[str], *, match_all: bool = True) -> list[str]

   Return subject UIDs whose indexed scans satisfy the slot filter.


.. py:function:: sync_xnat_project(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, config: nvitk.db.xnat_config.XnatConnectionConfig, *, catalog_path: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, subjects: str | Iterable[str] | None = None, subjects_file: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, id_type: str = 'subject', requested_sequences: str | Iterable[str] | None = None, download_root: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, download_dicoms: bool = False, download_niftis: bool = False, nifti_resource_label: str = 'NIFTI', nifti_download_root: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, skip_existing: bool = True, build_sqlite_index: bool = False, cohort_id: str | None = None, source_batch_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, pandas.DataFrame]

   Sync an XNAT project's subjects, sessions, scans, and (optionally) DICOM/NIfTI downloads into the
   dataset catalog tables. Resolves which subjects/sequences to pull via *catalog_path*/*subjects*/
   *subjects_file* and *requested_sequences* (falling back to the project's default sequence list),
   classifies each scan with :mod:`nvitk.db.xnat_projects` helpers, writes ``subjects``/``sessions``/
   ``scans``/``assets``/``subject_ids`` rows, enrolls synced subjects into *cohort_id*, and optionally
   downloads DICOM/NIfTI resources and rebuilds the SQLite index. Returns the written catalog frames.


.. py:function:: main(dataset_root: pathlib.Path, config_path: pathlib.Path | None, server: str | None, project: str | None, user: str | None, password: str | None, netrc_file: pathlib.Path | None, catalog_path: pathlib.Path | None, subjects: str | None, subjects_file: pathlib.Path | None, id_type: str, sequences: str | None, download_root: pathlib.Path | None, download_dicoms: bool, download_niftis: bool, nifti_resource_label: str, nifti_download_root: pathlib.Path | None, skip_existing: bool, build_sqlite_index: bool) -> None

   CLI entry point: resolve the XNAT connection profile from CLI flags/config file, then run
   :func:`sync_xnat_project` against the dataset at ``dataset_root``.
